newsitem.title: GERMANY: Gehe shares up after dividend news.
newsitem.headline: Gehe shares up after dividend news.

text.p: Shares in German pharmaceutical wholesaler Gehe AG rose strongly on Wednesday after the firm said it planned to pay a 1996 dividend of one mark (64 cents) per share plus a special payout of 30 pfennigs per share.
Gehe shares hit a high of 98 marks, rising almost four percent, before slipping back slightly to trade up 2.75 marks at 97 marks by 1028 GMT.
"The dividend was better-than-expected," said one dealer.
Meanwhile the rest of the market was also mostly firmer, the DAX index of 30 top German shares up 8.48 points, or 0.3 percent, at 2,823.61 points.

Gehe said it planned the extra dividend in order to allow shareholders to participate in the extraordinary earnings generated by the sale of its phamaceutical production division. ($ = 1.550 German Marks)
